summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by WeShop Holdings Ltd for April 2026, reporting financial results for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 and providing an investor presentation. The Form 6-K is a routine report of foreign private issuer earnings and business updates, with no mention of any special situation such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing does not involve any transaction, and the forward-looking statements are standard cautionary language. As a non-US issuer filing earnings results, this is a routine current report equivalent to a domestic 8-K earnings release. No special-situation categorization is appropriate.
